finance.title: Netflix, Disney and YouTube interested in FIFA World Cup U.S. rights, package could reach $2 billion
finance.summary: FIFA has alerted media companies that English- and Spanish-language U.S. rights are likely to be sold together for 2030 and 2034, likely driving up the price.
finance.title_cn: Netflix、迪士尼和YouTube对FIFA世界杯美国转播权感兴趣，套餐可能达到20亿美元
finance.summary_cn: 国际足联已提醒媒体公司，2030年和2034年的英语和西班牙语美国版权可能会一起出售，这可能会推高价格。

finance.title: DeSantis-backed 'Stop WOKE' law meets appeals court block, teeing up possible Supreme Court fight
finance.summary: A Trump-appointed judge ruled against Gov. Ron DeSantis' Stop WOKE Act, leaving Florida’s college speech limits blocked as a Supreme Court appeal looms.
finance.title_cn: 德桑蒂斯支持的“停止唤醒”法律遭到上诉法院的阻止，为最高法院可能的斗争做好准备
finance.summary_cn: 特朗普任命的一名法官否决了州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯的《停止觉醒法案》，导致佛罗里达州的大学演讲限制因最高法院上诉迫在眉睫而受阻。

finance.title: As chip sector takes it on the chin, traders bet on a big Nvidia rally
finance.summary: Shares of Nvidia fought into the green despite a 5% sell-off in chip stocks tracked by the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH).
finance.title_cn: 随着芯片行业陷入困境，交易员押注Nvidia将大幅上涨
finance.summary_cn: 尽管VanEck半导体ETF（SMH）追踪的芯片股下跌了5%，但英伟达股价仍上涨。

finance.title: The implications of Amazon's $25B bond sale, and Microsoft's evolving AI model strategy
finance.summary: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.
finance.title_cn: 亚马逊250亿美元债券出售的影响以及微软不断发展的人工智能模式战略
finance.summary_cn: 每个工作日，投资俱乐部都会发布最后冲刺;这是一个可操作的下午更新，正好赶上交易的最后一个小时。

finance.title: Strait of Hormuz threat level raised to 'severe' after Iran attacks tankers using U.S. Navy route
finance.summary: Iran's military has warned it will target ships that do not use a northern route approved by Tehran.
finance.title_cn: 伊朗袭击使用美国海军航线的油轮后，霍尔木兹海峡威胁级别升至“严重”
finance.summary_cn: 伊朗军方警告称，将针对不使用德黑兰批准的北方航线的船只。

ai.title: AI stocks fall after Samsung Electronics' strong profit forecast fails to impress
ai.description: AI stocks are seesawing lower and weighing on Wall Street. The S&P 500 slipped 0.2% Tuesday, even though the majority of stocks within the index rose. The drops for stocks in the artificial-intelligence industry dragged the Nasdaq down 0.8%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 133 points. The weakness began in Asia, where Samsung Electronics tumbled 6.9% in Seoul despite offering what analysts called a strong forecast for upcoming results. AI stocks worldwide have been under pressure because of worries their prices shot too high. Oil prices rose, which pushed upward on Treasury yields in the bond market.
ai.title_cn: 在三星电子强劲的利润预测未能给人留下深刻印象后，人工智能股票下跌
ai.description_cn: 人工智能股票正在拉锯战走低，给华尔街带来压力。尽管该指数中大多数股票上涨，但标准普尔500指数周二仍下跌0.2%。人工智能行业股票下跌拖累纳斯达克指数下跌0.8%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨133点。疲软始于亚洲，尽管分析师对即将到来的业绩做出了强劲的预测，但三星电子在首尔股价下跌6.9%。全球人工智能股票一直面临压力，因为人们担心它们的价格过高。油价上涨，推高了债券市场的国债收益率。

ai.title: Cleveland hosting international SIAM mathematics conference with 1,200 attendees
ai.description: More than 1,200 mathematicians, data scientists and computer engineers are gathering in Cleveland until Friday for the Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics Annual Meeting, highlighting how mathematics is driving advances in artificial intelligence, healthcare, climate science and education.
ai.title_cn: 克利夫兰举办国际SIAM数学会议，有1，200人参加
ai.description_cn: 超过1，200名数学家、数据科学家和计算机工程师将于周五齐聚克利夫兰，参加工业和应用数学学会年会，重点介绍数学如何推动人工智能、医疗保健、气候科学和教育领域的进步。

ai.title: Amazon raising $25B in bond sale, won't issue more debt in 2026
ai.description: It marks Amazon's latest debt raise as it looks to buttress its massive investments in artificial intelligence.
ai.title_cn: 亚马逊通过债券出售筹集250亿美元，2026年不会发行更多债务
ai.description_cn: 这标志着亚马逊最新的债务融资，因为它希望支持其对人工智能的大规模投资。

ai.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announces IIM Bangalore campus in Indonesia
ai.description: IIM Bangalore will establish its first overseas campus in Indonesia. This initiative aims to benefit youth across the entire ASEAN region. The campus will offer executive and degree-granting programs. It will focus on areas like artificial intelligence and digital transformation. This collaboration strengthens India-Indonesia educational ties significantly.
ai.title_cn: 总理纳伦德拉·莫迪宣布在印度尼西亚设立IIM班加罗尔校区
ai.description_cn: IIM班加罗尔将在印度尼西亚建立第一个海外园区。该倡议旨在造福整个东盟地区的年轻人。该校园将提供高管和学位授予课程。它将重点关注人工智能和数字化转型等领域。这种合作显着加强了印度与印度尼西亚的教育联系。

ai.title: UP Data Centre Policy 2026 Gets Cabinet Nod, Targets Rs 2 Lakh Cr Investment
ai.description: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet has approved the Uttar Pradesh Data Centre Policy 2026, aimed at positioning the state as a green, artificial intelligence (AI)-ready and globally competitive data centre hub.
ai.title_cn: UP 2026年数据中心政策获得内阁批准，目标投资2卢比
ai.description_cn: 北方邦内阁已批准《2026年北方邦数据中心政策》，旨在将该州定位为绿色、人工智能（AI）就绪且具有全球竞争力的数据中心中心。
